options.name: petal-x
options.title: 四瓣 X
options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a new original X-based brand icon exploration for KeepXClean, a calm reading and feed-filtering browser extension.
Feedback from user: previous thick rounded green X and K concepts look generic and unattractive. Completely rethink the silhouette; make this sophisticated, restrained and carefully proportioned. DO NOT produce the previous chunky crossed-pill shape.
Rendering: absolutely FLAT VECTOR-STYLE GRAPHIC on pure opaque WHITE background #FFFFFF, square canvas about1024px. One centered logo mark only, occupying 45–55% of image width, generous white space. NO text, captions, watermark, paper texture, alpha artifacts, blur, shadow, glow, metallic surfaces, 3D, reflections or gradients. Crisp clean edges and beautifully balanced negative space. Emerald #13865F is the primary brand color. The result is a brand design exploration, not a literal utility button icon. Do not reproduce the exact official X platform wordmark.
The idea must be immediately visible from its shape. No decorative sparkle, broom, shield, checkmark, tiny floating dots or unrelated add-on badges.
Primary request: a refined four-petal X mark. Four separate identical pointed-oval leaf-like geometric shapes sit on the FOUR DIAGONAL directions, NE, SE, SW, NW, with their inward tips stopping around a small diamond-shaped white breathing space. The shapes form an unmistakable diagonal X silhouette, NOT a plus sign and NOT a circular flower. Each petal is a softly rounded elongated kite with one elegantly pointed inner tip, approximately twice as long as wide. Convex outer ends, no chunky pill shapes. All four pieces are flat emerald. Perfect diagonal symmetry, generous clear spaces, friendly and refined, a memorable small reading-tool brand mark. Avoid looking organic or hand-drawn; use precise geometry.
